graph_origin.instructions: Choose stable caller enumeration for this narrow diagnostic repair, weighing minimal preservation versus source-oriented ordering.

criteria.ids: Make existing ID-index order the deterministic root enumeration and preserve all inner walk/dedup logic. Minimal change; determinism is for the same input ordering, not normalized source-path ordering.

pound_top.instructions: Choose whether the constant-language pound rule should align with the actual owner, become deliberately stricter, or remain deferred.

criteria.literal: Treat outside-plural pound as ordinary message text like the current public source/built API, explicitly accepting that the constant compiler admission changes. Preserve inside-plural and quoting behavior with independent regressions.
